'''Emmens''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]], he was stationed at the [[Imperial base camp]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Diplomatic Officer Emmens first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] as the Social Items Vendor on Ilum for the Empire.<ref name="TOR" />
